text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if an AI system learns from data that contains unfair patterns, it can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must check these systems carefully so they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another key issue—AI often needs large amounts of personal data, so we need strong rules to protect our information. Transparency is also important: people should understand how and why an AI makes a decision, especially when it affects their lives. Ultimately, responsible AI development means designing systems that are safe, accountable, and aligned with human values. We all have a role in guiding technology to be helpful, not harmful.
